title: Profiles: implement-tick, review-epic, closeout-epic resolve to executor, runner, model, prompt
description:
internal/profile: three role profiles, each exactly {executor, runner, model, prompt} (SPEC §4.5 Phase 1 rule: nothing else), versioned, resolved from a profiles/ directory in this repo with provenance recorded in the attempt record. Read .tick/runners.toml [roles.*] of the target repo for runner/model/tier the way tk herd does (contracts/runners-config-contract.json), so an operator keeps configuring runs in one place. review-epic and closeout-epic jobs run through the SAME subprocess executor at the controller checkout state (read-only source access grade for review), returning the role-result envelope (job-protocol.json) validated before the reconciler acts on it; a malformed result fails closed and leaves the process tick open.

## How this fits
Wave 4 of epic qeu. Integration commit fe23e80d52a483f696e9207e8fb4bbd183b3ee11 on epic/qeu contains the reconciler (px2, internal/reconcile + ticfac run-epic wiring in internal/cli), the executor (qg5, internal/exec/subprocess), the run-state store (xkd), the tk client (y7o) and the contract readers (b6s). Read internal/reconcile/doc.go and reconcile.go first: Options.Profile is today a plain string ('local-subprocess/implement-tick' default) digested into every evidence fingerprint (profile_digest) — this tick makes it a real, versioned profile resolved from a profiles/ directory in this repo, recorded with provenance in the attempt record, and wires the review-epic and closeout-epic role jobs through the SAME subprocess executor (role-result envelope from contracts/job-protocol.json, validated with internal/schema before the reconciler acts; malformed -> fail closed, process tick stays open). The reconciler's model reader for .tick/runners.toml (internal/reconcile/toml.go) parses ONLY [testing.commands] on purpose — add a separate narrow reader for [roles.*] (contracts/runners-config-contract.json has the cases; the parity reader in internal/contracts/parity/toml_cases_test.go is structural today and can become executable against your reader) rather than widening the gate reader. Executor argv per runner is in internal/exec/subprocess/runner.go (claude/codex/pi all verified live; runner is executor configuration via Options.Runner). A sibling worker (vcx) is concurrently fixing test fixtures in internal/exec/subprocess — do NOT edit that package; if the executor needs a change, report it in RESULT-q4u.md as a concern. Stdlib only, no go.mod/README.md/contracts/ edits. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor fe23e80d52a483f696e9207e8fb4bbd183b3ee11 HEAD.
